level_one.title: Mana Addict
level_one.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

level_four.title: Nether Wind
level_four.description: Increases Gravity Lapse's range by 30%. When Gravity Lapse hits an enemy Hero, refund 80 Mana.

level_seven.title: Burned Flesh
level_seven.description: When Flamestrike damages 2 or more Heroes, they take additional damage equal to 8% of their maximum Health.

level_ten.title: Pyroblast
level_ten.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

level_thirteen.title: Pyromaniac
level_thirteen.description: Each time Living Bomb deals periodic damage, Kael'thas's Basic Ability cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Fury of the Sunwell
level_sixteen.description: Flamestrike will explode a second time 1.5 seconds later.

level_twenty.title: Flamethrower
level_twenty.description: Increases the cast range of Flamestrike by 40%. If Flamestrike hits 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Hyper Shift
level_one.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 second.

level_four.title: Magic Spit
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Critical Mist
level_seven.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165 (+4% per level). Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

level_ten.title: Blink Heal
level_ten.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Pixie Power
level_thirteen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Pixie Dust by 3 seconds and increase the Spell Armor granted by 25.

level_sixteen.title: Critterize
level_sixteen.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

level_twenty.title: Faerie Protector
level_twenty.description: Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes.  Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.

level_one.title: Third Wind
level_one.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 (+4% per level) per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 (+4% per level) per second Restoration.

level_four.title: Reverberation
level_four.description: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

level_seven.title: Skullcracker
level_seven.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same enemy deals 90% bonus damage and Stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

level_ten.title: Avatar
level_ten.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Bronzebeard Rage
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Dwarf Launch
level_sixteen.description: Increase the range of Dwarf Toss by 30%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Dwarf Toss reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Mountain King
level_twenty.description: Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss each gain a 2nd charge.

level_one.title: Light of Karabor
level_one.description: Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 40%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased to 80%.

level_four.title: Aegis of Light
level_four.description: Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 40 Armor for 5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Righteous Momentum
level_seven.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while Channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.

level_ten.title: Sacred Ground
level_ten.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

level_thirteen.title: Aldor Peacekeeper
level_thirteen.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Vindication at maximum charge deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Templar's Verdict
level_sixteen.description: Righteous Hammer reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds and deals bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.

level_twenty.title: Seraphim
level_twenty.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Perfect Aim
level_one.description: Increases Gilnean Cocktail's range by 30% and refunds 45 Mana if it hits an enemy Hero.

level_four.title: Thick Skin
level_four.description: Using Darkflight grants 50 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks while in Worgen Form, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

level_seven.title: Incendiary Elixir
level_seven.description: Quest: Reduce the cooldown of Gilnean Cocktail by 2 seconds. Every time Greymane hits an enemy Hero with the explosion damage from Gilnean Cocktail, increase its explosion damage by 25, up to 375.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, the cooldown is reduced by an additional 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Cursed Bullet
level_ten.description: Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.  Does not affect Vehicles.

level_thirteen.title: Running Wild
level_thirteen.description: Increases Darkflight and Disengage's range by 35%, and reduce their cooldowns by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Lord of His Pack
level_sixteen.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases Greymane's Basic Attack damage by 25% for 3 seconds, increased to 50% while in Worgen Form.

level_twenty.title: Gilnean Roulette
level_twenty.description: Cursed Bullet's damage is reduced to 30% of current health but its cooldown is reduced by 24 seconds.

level_one.title: Colossal Totem
level_one.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

level_four.title: Earthliving Enchant
level_four.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Grounded Totem
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 15% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's cast range by 45%.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Tidal Waves
level_thirteen.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

level_sixteen.title: Earthgrasp Totem
level_sixteen.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Farseer's Blessing
level_twenty.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

level_one.title: Consume Vitality
level_one.description: Skeletal Swing's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit heal Leoric for 4% of his maximum Health.

level_four.title: Ghastly Reach
level_four.description: Increase the range of Skeletal Swing by 25%.

level_seven.title: Hopelessness
level_seven.description: Increase the range of Drain Hope by 25%.

level_ten.title: Entomb
level_ten.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Unyielding Despair
level_thirteen.description: Drain Hope's cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds for every 1 second it is active. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, its cooldown is reduced by an additional 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Crushing Hope
level_sixteen.description: If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, it instantly deals an additional 15% of the target's maximum Health as damage. This damage does not heal Leoric.

level_twenty.title: Buried Alive
level_twenty.description: The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50 (+4% per level) damage every 1 second.

level_one.title: Echo of the Elements
level_one.description: Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 2 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning.  Reward: After killing 20 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.  Reward: After killing 50 enemies, Chain Lightning gains an extra charge.  Mythic Reward: After killing 125 enemies, Chain Lightning can now strike the same target multiple times, and also strikes 1 additional target per bounce.

level_four.title: Mana Tide
level_four.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Ancestral Wrath
level_seven.description: Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt.  Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

level_ten.title: Sundering
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

level_thirteen.title: Frostwolf's Grace
level_thirteen.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

level_sixteen.title: Thunderstorm
level_sixteen.description: Chain Lightning Slows the primary target by 8% for 2 seconds when used on Heroes.  Quest: Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.  Reward: While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 30%.  Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

level_twenty.title: Worldbreaker
level_twenty.description: Lower the cooldown of Sundering by 40 seconds. After Sundering impacts, it leaves behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Unrelenting Torment
level_one.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

level_four.title: Haunting Arrows
level_four.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Lost Soul
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 0.75 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

level_ten.title: Mind Control
level_ten.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Remorseless
level_thirteen.description: Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.  Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

level_sixteen.title: Will of the Forsaken
level_sixteen.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Dark Lady's Call
level_twenty.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

level_one.title: Justice for All
level_one.description: Increase the Shield applied to allies by Righteousness to 80% of the Shield gained by Tyrael.

level_four.title: Reciprocate
level_four.description: When Tyrael's Shield from Righteousness expires or is destroyed, it deals 170 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Heroes and Summons.  For each enemy Hero damaged by Reciprocate or El'Druin's Might, Tyrael heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Burning Halo
level_seven.description: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 12 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 125% for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Judgment
level_ten.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Sword of Justice
level_thirteen.description: Upon teleporting using El'druin's Might, El'druin swaps places with Tyrael, and El'druin's Might can be reactivated to teleport an additional time.

level_sixteen.title: Bound by Law
level_sixteen.description: El'Druin's Might's Slow is increased to 65% for 1 second, decaying to 30% over the remaining duration.

level_twenty.title: Angel of Justice
level_twenty.description: Increases the cast range of Judgment by 50%, and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.
